'''Robert John Russell''' is founder and Director of the [[Center for Theology and the Natural Sciences]] (CTNS). He is also the Ian G. Barbour Professor of Theology and Science in Residence at the [[Graduate Theological Union]] (GTU).<ref name=CTNS>{{cite web|url=https://www.ctns.org/about_founder.html|title=Founder|publisher=The Center for Theology and the Natural Sciences|accessdate=2009-05-31}}</ref> He has written and edited extensively on possible scientific mechanisms of Christian belief.

Russell is an ordained minister in the [[United Church of Christ]]. He received a [[Ph.D.]] in physics from the [[University of California, Santa Cruz]], a [[Bachelor of Science|B.S.]] in physics from [[Stanford University]], an [[Master of Science|M.S.]] in physics from [[UCLA]], and an M.A. in Theology and an M. Div. from [[Pacific School of Religion]]. Russell taught physics at [[Carleton College]] and science and religion with [[Ian Barbour]] for several years before joining the GTU in 1981. His wife, Charlotte, is an associate minister at First Congregational Church, [[Berkeley, California]].<ref name=CTNS/>

==Ideas==
From 1984 to the present, Robert John Russell has published papers exploring consonance and dissonance between modern physics, evolutionary biology and Christian theology.<ref>{{cite book|last=Russell|first=Robert John|title=Cosmology: From Alpha to Omega|year=2008|publisher=Fortress Press|location=Minneapolis, MN|isbn=978-0-8006-6273-8|pages=344}}</ref>

He is the Principal Investigator of "STARS: Science and Transcendence Advanced Research Series".<ref>[[John Templeton Foundation]]. [http://www.templeton.org/what-we-fund/grants/science-and-transcendence-advanced-research-series-stars Science and Transcendence Advanced Research Series (STARS)]</ref>

In ''God’s Action in Nature’s World: Essays in Honour of Robert John Russell'', 15 writers on the interaction between theology and science analysed their views of Russell’s contribution to the subject.<ref>{{cite journal|last=Knight|first=Christopher C.|year=2008|title=Book Review: ''God's Action in Nature's World: Essays in Honour of Robert John Russell''|journal=[[Science & Christian Belief]]|volume=20|issue=2|pages=214–215|url=https://www.scienceandchristianbelief.org/download_pdf_free.php?filename=SCB+20-2+reviews.pdf|archive-date=2016-10-03|access-date=2016-09-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161003064327/https://www.scienceandchristianbelief.org/download_pdf_free.php?filename=SCB+20-2+reviews.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
